senses.gloss: m. (גְּרַס II) acquired learning, tradition, study by heart.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:2">Targ. Cant. I, 2</cite> <he>בג׳</he> for study by heart (oral tradition).—
<cite ref="Megillah 6b:4">Meg. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>לאוקומי ג׳ וכ׳</he> to preserve (remember) what one has learned, requires divine assistance.
<cite ref="Shabbat 21b:2">Sabb. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ דינקותא</he> acquired in early youth (which is better remembered).
<cite ref="Shabbat 30b:1">Ib. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>לא … פומיה מג׳</he> did not cease studying by heart; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:8">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>מגִּרְסֵיה</he>.—Pl. <he>גִּירְסַיָּיא</he>.
B. Bath. 22ᵃ they may be disturbed. מגִּירְסַייְהוּ in their studies. [In later literature גִּירְסָא version.]
